Identity.Title: Device identity
Identity.Subtitle: This identity signs package publishing and other authenticated changes.
Identity.KeyWarning: Your device key is stored only on this computer and protected by the system's secret store. It is worth keeping a backup of your profiles and packages: if the key is lost (for example after reinstalling the system), you cannot recover ownership of published packages or your identity in communities.
Identity.SavedOffline: Nickname saved locally; the server will receive it after reconnecting.
Identity.Registered: The device identity is registered online.
Identity.Error.Nick: The nickname must be 1–40 characters and contain no control characters.
Identity.Error.KeyStore: The device key could not be safely read or created. Check that the secret store is available.
Identity.Error.Save: The nickname could not be safely saved to settings; the existing settings file was left unchanged.
Identity.Error.Offline: The service could not be reached or the device could not be registered. Try again later.
